plain_text:
SPECIAL PUBLIC HEARING MEETING OF THE 
BOARD OF SCHOOL COMMITTEE  
MANCHESTER SCHOOL DISTRICT SAU #37 
 
August 24, 2026 6:30 p.m.  
 
1. Mayor Ruais calls the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m. 
 
2. The Clerk called the roll.  
 
Present:  Committee Members Turner, Parr, Georges, Want, Taylor, Bergeron, 
Stewart, O’Connell, Potter, St. John, Garrity, Hamer, O’Neil-Wong 
(6:31), Smith and Mayor Ruais. 
 
Absent: Committee Members Bergeron. 
 
3. Mayor Ruais advises the purpose of the special public hearing meeting is to give the 
residents of Manchester the opportunity to address the board regarding a donation of 138 
musical instruments from The Break Room, with a value of $28,300.  All people wishing 
to speak will have up to three (3) minutes to do so, and any comments must be directed to 
the chair.  Any resident wishing to speak will come forward to the nearest microphone, 
clearly state their name and address when recognized and give their comments. 
 
No members of the public were signed up to speak. 
 
Committee Member Want thanked the donating organization and emphasized the significance of 
the gift and the impact it would have on Manchester students. 
 
Superintendent Dr. Camille added that the District had been working to provide follow-up 
information demonstrating how donated resources are ultimately used. She described the musical 
instrument donation as an extraordinary gift and stated that the Board would receive future 
updates from Mr. Doyle regarding implementation. 
 
 
5. This being a special meeting of the board, no further business can be presented unless by 
2/3 majority and a motion is in order to adjourn. 
 
 
This being a special meeting, no further business was discussed.  On motion of Committee 
Member Parr, duly seconded by Committee Member O’Connell, it was moved to adjourn.  
All were in favor, meeting adjourned at 6:31 p.m.
August 24, 2026, Board of School Committee
